description: This file contains partial class definitions for AWS DynamoDB configuration and helper classes used within the Orleans clustering framework, including options classes, helper methods, and extension methods for clustering setup.

classes.name: DynamoDBClientOptions
classes.description: Represents configuration options for DynamoDB client, including credentials and service information.

classes.name: DynamoDBGatewayListProviderHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing DynamoDB gateway list provider, content not detailed.

classes.name: DynamoDBMembershipHelper
classes.description: Contains static helper method for parsing DynamoDB connection strings into clustering options.

classes.name: DynamoDBClusteringOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for DynamoDB clustering, including throughput and table settings.

classes.name: DynamoDBClusteringSiloOptions
classes.description: Options for configuring DynamoDB clustering at the silo level, specifically connection string.

classes.name: DynamoDBGatewayOptions
classes.description: Options related to the DynamoDB gateway for clustering, including throughput and table details.

methods.name: ParseDataConnectionString
methods.description: Static method to parse DynamoDB connection string into clustering options.

methods.name: UseDynamoDBClustering
methods.description: Extension method for IClientBuilder and ISiloBuilder to configure DynamoDB clustering with specified options.
